reviews.title: Parcel & Post : Express Tracking
reviews.text:
I have never known to ever have to pay £10 a week or £60 a year to track a parcel???

reviews.title: waste of time

If you're going to make us pay for the app then disclose that information first.  i don't want to hear anything about the "three day free trial" because even if i wanted to do that then id still have to pay 10 pounds if i forgot to cancel it. This app is just money hungry and useless 0/10
